title: [Formatter feature request] Config option for trailing comma
author: gryznar
body_preview: # Problem Ruff currently always enforces trailing commas with no option to disable them. As a modern, versatile Python tool, offering flexibility over code style choice (such as trailing comma preference) is essential for adoption across diverse team preferences.  # ​Proposed Solution Add a configuration setting to enable or disable trailing commas, defaulting to the current behavior (enabled).

title: Nested .gitignore negations can never re-include what an ancestor excluded
author: KaizenShogun
body_preview: **Describe the bug**  A negation in a nested `.gitignore` can never re-include something an ancestor `.gitignore` excluded. Git decides the other way round: the *deepest* gitignore file that has a matching pattern wins, and only inside that file does last-match-win. Black ORs across gitignore files, so the deepest one — the only one that can say `!` — is often never consulted.  Effect: `black .` s...
